localEquivalence.result: the provider exists for chat only; no TTS or STT path reaches Pollinations today, so this module is the whole audio delta

exports.pollinationsTtsAdapter: default TTS adapter instance; synthesize(text, model, credentials, responseFormat, options)
exports.pollinationsSttAdapter: default STT adapter instance; transcribe({ model, formData, credentials, kind, signal })
exports.createPollinationsTtsAdapter: factory; options { fetchImpl, timeoutMs, maxAudioBytes } for tests
exports.createPollinationsSttAdapter: factory; options { fetchImpl, timeoutMs, maxTranscriptBytes } for tests
exports.buildPollinationsSpeechRequest: (model, text, options) -> source speech body; throws status 400
exports.buildPollinationsTranscriptionRequest: async (model, formData, { kind }) -> { body: FormData, responseFormat } or a 400 error result with local: true
exports.matchesContainer: (container, bytes) leading-byte check for mp3, opus (Ogg), aac (ADTS/ADIF), flac, wav
exports.pollinationsAcceptedJob: (modality, jobState) accepted-job accounting with unknown cost
exports.POLLINATIONS_AUDIO_DEFINITION: audio fields to merge into the existing pollinations registry entry (addServiceKinds, ttsConfig, sttConfig)
exports.POLLINATIONS_STT_MODELS: transcription models with per-model response formats
exports.POLLINATIONS_SPEECH_RESPONSE_FORMATS: containers plus "ogg" (alias of opus) and "json" (gateway wrapper)

auth.restriction: Audio requires a real selected API key; noauth, public and sk_durindoor placeholders fail locally without submission. Existing chat keyless behavior is preserved.

models.voiceSuffix: tts model/voice accepted; default voice alloy
models.dynamicDiscovery: No audio discovery in the pinned source: static default/whisper rows only. Existing chat discovery must remain chat-only; do not infer audio support from /v1/models.

speech.body: { model, input, voice, response_format, speed, instructions? }
speech.answer: audio bytes in the requested container

transcription.body: model, language?, prompt?, response_format?, temperature?, timestamp_granularities[]*, file
transcription.answer: json / verbose_json object with text, or text/plain
